Before using the modeler, first import a modeler.
After importing the modeler, you need to change the modeler to a vertical position to wear the costume.
The position of the modeler can be changed by inserting the action in the viewport folder.
Click on the modeler, double-click the folder, view all costumes, and select the costume you need.
If you need a female jacket, you can find the corresponding Women Jacket folder.
After opening the camera, you can see the style chart at the bottom.
After the camera style chart, you can import the costume according to your needs.
After importing, you can open the simulation, the costume will be worn on the virtual modeler.

summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will walk through the essential steps to use the modeler in Marvelous Designer. This guide is designed to help you import and manipulate costumes effectively. ## Importing the Modeler Before using the modeler, the first step is to **import a modeler**. ## Adjusting the Modeler Position After importing the modeler, you need to change its position to a **vertical orientation** to properly wear the costume. You can change the position of the modeler by inserting the action in the **viewport folder**. ## Selecting and Importing Costumes 1. Click on the modeler. 2. Double-click the folder to view all available costumes. 3. Select the costume you need. For instance, if you require a female jacket, navigate to the corresponding **Women Jacket** folder. ## Viewing the Style Chart After opening the camera, you will see the **style chart** at the bottom of the interface. This style chart allows you to assess different styles and make selections based on your project needs. ## Importing Costumes Following the camera style chart, you can import the costume according to your needs. Once imported, you can initiate the simulation process, which allows the costume to be worn on the virtual modeler. ## Modifying the Costume After importing and simulating the costume, you have the flexibility to **modify the modeling costume** according to your specific requirements. This feature enables you to tailor the design to fit your vision effectively. ```
